sources_considered.why: Original announcement supplies development duration and comparisons with GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.
A November 16, 2023 revision preserves contemporary release dates, benchmarks, and limitations.
Contemporary interview reporting supplies the company-to-release interval; a comparably dated primary founding record was not located.

evidence_items.locator: The journey to Grok-1; opening paragraph and benchmark table
evidence_items.explanation: The announcement reports four months of development and scores above GPT-3.5 on its displayed mathematics, knowledge, and coding benchmarks. It also reports lower scores than GPT-4 and states that Grok lacked vision and audio, consistent with substantial but incomplete replication.

evidence_items.locator: Introduction; News; Model Performance table; FAQ
evidence_items.explanation: This contemporary revision records the November 2 base-model release and Yi-34B's 76.3 MMLU score, alongside reasoning, reading, mathematics, and coding evaluations. Its FAQ still describes the public chat version as forthcoming, limiting any inference of complete ChatGPT product replication.

unresolved_gaps: No comprehensive independent comparison measures the fraction of OpenAI's entire product portfolio reproduced.
The benchmark results use developer-selected evaluations and do not establish identical real-world performance.
